lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 fixed the factual error in ADR 0006 section 4 ('BLOCK escalation'). The old bullet incorrectly claimed that pause-operator calls escalateFn and maintains phase:planning. The corrected section now has two sub-bullets: (a) pause-operator returns awaiting-operator-approval with no escalateFn call, exitPhaseAfterPlan transitions to awaiting-operator; (b) audit-blocked calls escalateFn and returns escalated, exitPhaseAfterPlan transitions to idle. Both paths are explicit that phase:planning is never maintained. All 2602 tests pass. check:all exits 0. All 8 stories now have passes:true. The remaining reviewer findings (rounds 1+2) are SUGGESTION severity (no WARNING or CRITICAL). PRD is complete -- reviewer should run next.
